name: each-value-the-call-gives-is-refused-at-the-path-its-frame-names
query: [1 "x"] | sum !| get [~(tag) ~(trace | first | path) ~(subject | found | get /1 | tag)]

name: a-step-lists-its-refusals-on-its-noun
query: ::path | binding | value | get /0 | filter ~(get /name | eq :throws) | map ~(get /modifiers | first) | filter ~(eq :KeyNotInMapError) | count

name: a-noun-lists-each-refusal-once
query: ::vec | binding | value | get /0 | filter ~(get /name | eq :throws) | map ~(get /modifiers | first) | filter ~(eq :PayloadKindNotTakenError) | count

name: two-sites-share-the-last-name-of-the-rule-they-refuse
query: get [~([::construct{:tag ::Box :payload ::call{:name :count}}] | tag ::quote !| tag) ~([[::call{:name :count}]] | tag ::quote !| tag)] | map ~(toString | split "/" | last)

name: a-refusal-holds-the-value-it-refuses-whatever-the-subject-equals
query: get [~([1] | with {:v ~it} ~(v 1 !| payload | has /found)) ~(:v [1]; [1] | v 1 !| payload | has /found) ~("zz" | toRegex "zz" !| flags | found) ~([1] | apply ~(it) [1] !| args | found) ~("x" | tag ::number !| found)]

name: a-refusal-of-the-subject-its-step-was-served-pours-the-subject-the-call-gave
query: get [~(::W"x" | toNumber !| get [~(payload | keys) ~(subject | found)]) ~(1e10 | range !| payload | keys) ~(::Width#2.5 | range !| payload | keys) ~(42 | keys !| payload | keys) ~([] | union !| payload | keys) ~("x{" | parseJson !| payload | keys)]

name: a-primitive-that-refuses-the-value-its-call-served-holds-it-under-the-subject
query: get [~(:k | toNumber !| subject | found) ~("a b" | toTag !| subject | found) ~("x" | toPath !| subject | found) ~(true | count !| found) ~([] | minus !| subject | found)]

name: a-refusal-of-a-kind-names-the-kinds-its-holder-takes
query: get [~([1 "x"] | sum !| subject | expected) ~({:a "x"} | avg !| subject | expected) ~(["a" 2] | join "," !| subject | expected) ~([#[1] 5] | union !| subject | expected) ~([[1] 2] | zip !| subject | expected) ~([1 2] | filter ~(1) !| predicate | expected) ~({:a 1} | every ~(1) !| predicate | expected) ~(5 | allOf ~(1) !| conditions | expected) ~(5 | cond ~(1) ~(2) !| clauses | expected) ~(::vec | doc [:take 1] !| anchor | expected) ~(::kind | impl 5 !| expected)]

name: a-refusal-a-primitive-raises-of-a-value-of-none-of-its-kinds-takes-the-kind-of-the-verdicts-of-its-verb
query: [1 2] | filter ~(1) !| get [~(predicate | expected) ~(predicate | answer | tag) ~(::vec/filter/PredicateAnswerKindNotTakenError/predicate | doc | eq (::vec/filter/predicate | doc))]

name: a-refusal-a-primitive-raises-of-its-subject-takes-the-kind-of-the-verdicts-of-its-verb
query: "x" | toNumber !| get [~(subject | found) ~(::string/toNumber/TextNotNumberError/subject | doc | eq (::string/toNumber/SubjectNotStringError/subject | doc))]

name: a-refusal-a-primitive-raises-of-an-input-its-rule-does-not-hold-of-takes-the-kind-of-the-verdicts-of-its-verb
query: "a" | toRegex "q" !| get [~(flags | found) ~(::string/toRegex/FlagsNotFlagsError/flags | doc | eq (::string/toRegex/flags | doc))]

name: a-refusal-of-an-empty-subject-takes-the-kind-of-the-verdicts-of-its-verb
query: [] | union !| get [~(tag) ~(subject | found) ~(::vec/union/SubjectEmptyError/subject | doc | eq (::vec/union/SubjectNotVecError/subject | doc))]

name: the-slot-of-a-role-is-a-value-of-the-kind-of-a-slot-read-by-the-record-of-its-role
query: get [~("x" | add 1 !| subject | get [~(is ::fn/slot) ~(doc | eq (::fn/subject | doc)) ~(found)]) ~(1 | add "x" !| addend | get [~(is ::fn/slot) ~(doc | eq (::number/add/addend | doc))]) ~(::number/add/subject | doc | eq (::fn/subject | doc))]

name: a-refusal-of-a-step-of-the-language-links-the-page-of-its-site
query: [::call ::bind ::construct ::fail ::group ::quote ::error] | map ~(with {:site ~it} ~(manifest | filter ~(binding | name | toString | endsWith "Error") | map ~(doc | links | map ~(answer) | has site) | every ~(it)))
